primaryDirectives:
- [ ] Never modify the database schema without asking.
- [ ] Always run `dart analyze` after making changes.
quickInstructions: - [ ] Execute instructions directly against the active task.
previewModeInstructions:
- [ ] PREVIEW MODE: Do NOT execute code mutations.
- [ ] CHECKLIST GENERATION: List exactly what will be changed, warnings, conflicts, and questions. Store strictly as a JSON array of objects inside `<preview>[{"description": "...", "goal": "..."}]</preview>`.
- [ ] NOTES CONSTRAINT: Do NOT put preview/planned changes into the `<bridge_notes>` tag. Keep notes extremely brief or empty.
previewApprovedInstructions: - [ ] PREVIEW APPROVED: Proceed with code execution EXACTLY as planned.
previewRejectedInstructions:
- [ ] PREVIEW REJECTED: The preview items are NOT approved. You are strictly FORBIDDEN from executing file modifications, shell commands, or code.
- [ ] RE-EVALUATION: Adjust the implementation based on comments, update preview items, and wait for further review.
systemHooksInstructions:
- [ ] SAFETY CHECK: If the task is unclear, unsafe, or requires clarification, DO NOT execute code; output `<preview>` containing questions and write `PREVIEW` to `.ai_bridge/agent_status.txt`.
- [ ] DATA MUTATION: Read active task context from `.ai_bridge/current_task.json`. Never edit `.ai_bridge/tasks.json` directly.
- [ ] PROGRESS NOTES: Write progress notes to `.ai_bridge/latest_notes.json` and verification proofs to `.ai_bridge/latest_verification.json` on disk. Do NOT output XML tags (`<bridge_notes>`, `<verification>`) in the console results or chat under any circumstances.
- [ ] QUEUE RELEASE: Overwrite `.ai_bridge/agent_status.txt` with `IDLE` (or `PREVIEW` if awaiting review) as your final step.
- [ ] BLOCK SCREEN: At the very end of your response, output: "please send the block screen message once."
- [ ] REUSABILITY: Extract every reusable component (buttons, cards, list items) into separate, stateless sub-widgets or helper methods.
syncErrorInstructions: - [ ] AI Bridge Sync Error: The system detected you outputted conversational/status information directly in your response chat outside of the required PRIMARY DIRECTIVES method.
endingInstructions:

[x] latest_notes.json
[x] latest_verification.json

### Isolate Custom Commit Notes

Updated copy, send, and commit actions to save notes in SharedPreferences rather than task notes database.
Added `onChanged` and `onSubmitted` handlers to save the notes in real-time as the user types.
Verified that all 65 unit tests compile and pass without regressions.

### Update - 2026-05-24 10:14
### Active Tasks Commit Note Input Box
- Implemented a modern, responsive text input box at the top of the **Active Tasks** tab in [version_control_window.dart](file:///C:/Development/Music/Project/lib/screens/visual_editor/panels/version_control_window.dart).
- The text input box is active when there are active tasks, and is disabled with custom placeholder text when the active task list is empty.
- Added two-way state syncing: changes to the input box automatically update the primary active task's `notes` property in the database. External changes to the task notes are also synced back to the input box when it is not focused, preventing cursor jump bugs.
- Integrated pre-saving checks so that the user's typed note is saved to the active task before clipboard prompt compilation, AI bridge dispatch, or commit execution is triggered.
- The custom note is automatically formatted and appended to the commit name as `(Note: custom_note)` when the task is committed manually or automatically.

---

### Update - 2026-05-24 08:35
### Audio Player Lockup & Test Suite Synchronization Fixes
- Resolved the permanent `Assertion: [Player] has been disposed` crash on `AudioPlayer` by introducing a robust proxy stream mechanism in `AudioPlayerService`. Now, `AudioPlayer` is dynamically recreated on demand if disposed (e.g. during a hot reload or window switch) while maintaining persistent stream subscription bindings to external listeners.
- Fully bypassed network-dependent mock audio loading by utilizing a silent local base64 data URI fallback (`data:audio/wav;base64,...`) when physical file checking fails, preventing TCP connection timeouts and media_kit driver disposal cycles.
- Fixed SharedPreferences instance caching in unit tests inside `AiBridgeService`'s `_getPrefs()` helper method, ensuring that test isolation configuration (mock initial values) behaves correctly.

---

### Update - 2026-05-24 08:26
Fixed database dump sync deadlock issue by removing `await syncDatabaseDump()` from the critical task-saving path `_save()` and running it in the background with a 1-second timeout. Also wrapped all Drift select queries inside `syncDatabaseDump()` with an 800ms timeout. Pre-cached the SharedPreferences singleton in `AiBridgeService` using a new `_getPrefs()` helper method to completely eliminate native platform channel calls and deadlocks during active watcher state processing.

---

### Update - 2026-05-24 08:16
Verified that commit verification checks exist on auto-commits/pushes and enhanced the git error capture to query native git status/conflicts. Also integrated the same Git push error handling into manual task committing, made Git error detection in the diagnostic window case-insensitive and robust, and successfully verified compile and test suites pass.
